title: Manita palette
brief: Pick a non-orange palette for the Manita app icon and website; same tilted foam hand with sleeve

artboards.title: Indigo + mint
artboards.tradeoff: Calm, premium and techy; least playful

artboards.title: Cobalt + lemon
artboards.tradeoff: Loud and friendly, very visible; yellow needs dark text

artboards.title: Forest + coral
artboards.tradeoff: Warm and handmade; softer at small sizes

artboards.title: Graphite + neon pink
artboards.tradeoff: Bold dark style that pops; dark site is less approachable

artboards.title: Retro 30s · cream paper
artboards.tradeoff: Warm vintage cartoon, unmistakably its own; cream reads soft at 16 px

artboards.title: Retro 30s · black film
artboards.tradeoff: High contrast title-card look, pops in the Dock; darker, more dramatic site
